units.title: Number Systems and Boolean Algebra

units.title: Simplification of Boolean Functions
topics: five and six variable maps – Product of Sums and Sum of Products – NAND and NOR implementation – Don’t-Care conditions – The tabulation method

units.title: Sequential Logic and Circuits
